description: This file defines a JUnit test rule (MqttServerRule) for testing MQTT client components by simulating an MQTT server behavior. It manages a server socket that accepts incoming connections and can be used to test connection handling in MQTT client code.

classes.name: MqttServerRule
classes.description: A JUnit external resource rule that starts and manages a mock MQTT server socket for testing purposes.

methods.name: MqttServerRule
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the server rule with a specific port and logs the start of the server.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Starts the server socket and launches an asynchronous thread to accept incoming connections, logging each connection.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Closes the server socket to stop the server, handling potential IOExceptions gracefully.
